zh.title: 民航局宣布光復節連假離島航線8月24日開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局宣布光復節連假離島管制航線8月24日開放訂位，共提供1072架次。
body: 交通部民用航空局於8月20日宣布，今年光復節連假期間，澎湖、金門及馬祖三離島管制航線將提供1,072架次，共計87,268個座位數。相關機票預計於8月24日上午9時起統一開放旅客訂位。
民航局規劃自10月23日至10月27日劃定為期5天的航空疏運期。各航線運能分配方面，澎湖航線將提供458架次與33,116個座位，金門航線提供480架次與45,072個座位，馬祖航線則提供134架次與9,080個座位。

en.title: Taiwan CAA to Open Ticket Booking for Holiday Flights to Offshore Islands on August 24
en.summary: Taiwan CAA will open ticket booking for offshore island holiday routes on August 24 with 1,072 flights.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration of Taiwan announced that ticket booking for controlled air routes to Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu during the upcoming Retrocession Day holiday will open at 9:00 AM on August 24. A total of 1,072 flights providing 87,268 seats have been arranged for the travel period.

The official holiday transport period will run for five days from October 23 to October 27, 2026. Under the current schedule, the Penghu route will offer 458 flights with 33,116 seats, the Kinmen route will provide 480 flights with 45,072 seats, and the Matsu route will supply 134 flights with 9,080 seats.
